findings.statement: The first common exact owner quotient is D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS, so absolute owner identity D0 versus D1 is not required by the tested scalar exchange law.
D_MERGED loses 27 structural directions and leaves eight scalar contradictions on 4x5-k4. Some owner-channel asymmetry remains load-bearing there.
On 4x5-k4, adding absolute positive/negative owner-channel imbalances to merged D totals restores exactness at rank 254, eight below the separated-owner control rank 262.
The tested scalar carrier is invariant to global swapping of the two absolute owner labels once D totals and absolute per-sign channel imbalances are retained.
6x3-k3 and 6x3-k4 need no owner-channel distinction at all under the frozen carrier; 4x5-k4 alone forces the symmetric imbalance refinement.
